name: Darren Baker
source:
While pretty standard as far as libraries go, the one on campus nevertheless provides everything you'd ever expect or need as a college student.

For Darren, the silence is its greatest service.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/vnstudioelan/status/1615398735281889280]Twitter[/url]]
